host.title: Local IP of Daikin Air Purifier

code.title: Authorization Code (experimental)
code.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty: the plugin is read-only. A code works a single time; after the first login the plugin saves and renews its own tokens.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (experimental)
refreshToken.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Alternative to the authorization code.

uuid.title: Cognito UUID
uuid.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty.

terminalId.title: Terminal ID
terminalId.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty.

port.title: Port
port.description: Experimental cloud control, not supported. Leave empty.

cacheDuration.title: Cache Duration (seconds)
cacheDuration.description: How often the purifier is polled on the local network.
